

`internal/cli/reviews.go`: `Client` methods for every route above, and
`ReviewTable(w, []model.Review)`, `ReviewRender(w, model.Review)` (header,
roster with each reviewer's current verdict, threads grouped by subject and
section with their quote and messages, rounds), `ReviewThreadRender`.
`internal/cmd/review.go`, the WL-REQ-1775 entries this part builds:

```
lode review add <doc-ref>                        (task refs: part 2)
lode review list [--mine] [--open] [--json]
lode review show <id> [--json]
lode review comment <id> --anchor <ref>[#sec-N] --quote "…" --intent question|change_request|note --body "…"
lode review comment <id> --thread <thread-id> --body "…"
lode review resolve <thread-id> [--obsolete]
lode review approve <id>
lode review set verdict changes_requested <id>
lode review submit <id>                          author round; doc: current version
lode review wait <id> [--after <seq>] [--timeout <s>]
```

Two flags here are not in the WL-REQ-1775 catalogue and need an amendment
to it, filed with this plan's review: `comment --quote`, because a review
thread on a document needs a byte range (WL-REQ-1317) and `--anchor` alone
names only a subject or section; and `wait --after <seq>`, because an author
loop has to say what it has already seen, and the envelope's `after` is what
it passes back. `--focused` on `approve` and `set verdict` is part 3's. No
`--body-file` and no `--note`: `--body "$(cat f)"` does the first, and
`overall_note` reaches the API through `lode review` only when WL-REQ-1775
gains a flag for it.

`comment --anchor` is the terminal's text selection (WL-REQ-1317): the
client fetches the subject at its current version (`lode doc show --json`
for a document, the rule's text for a rule ref), finds `--quote` as an exact
substring (inside the named section when `#sec-N` is given), and posts the
version, the byte range and the quote. For a spec the range is into the
rendered body the client has, and the server maps it (Task 7); for a rule
or a plan it is into the stored text. Zero or several hits is an error that
names the offsets. `comment` fills `RaisedByTask`/`RaisedBySession` from
`currentTaskID()`/`currentSessionID()` the way `lode doc note` does. `wait`
prints one tagged JSON envelope (`{"review": id, "after": seq, "threads": …,
"messages": …}`) and exits 0; `--timeout` elapsed prints nothing, exits 0;
no open review exits 1. `--mine` filters by the caller's actor (from
`whoami`). Register `review` as an L1 entity in `internal/cmd/CLAUDE.md`
and `namerule_test.go`; add the verbs to `docs/agent-surfaces.md`.

First cmd test (`internal/cmd/review_test.go`, the `runLode` harness): add,
comment question with a quote on a spec section (the stored thread names the
rule), comment --thread (reply), approve; `lode review show --json` has one
thread with the byte range and quote, two messages, one round; `lode review
show` (human) prints the reviewer's verdict line; an ambiguous `--quote`
fails with both offsets named.
